## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceProposalNotFound` — no proposal is stored under the id.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::an_unknown_proposal_is_not_there`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::an_unknown_proposal_is_not_there). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceProposalNotFound — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let g = Governed::new();
let id = g.propose_fee(&g.a, 100);
assert_eq!(id, 1);
Some(rejected!(g
    .f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_sign(&g.b, &(id + 999))))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked an_unknown_proposal_is_not_there
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Use an existing proposal id returned by `governance_propose`; ids are sequential and unknown ids are rejected by sign, veto, and execute.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model)
